reviews.comment: He's a great professor who goes through problems you'll see on the exam and explains every step. The hw is easy, he only assigns like 8 in total. He'll do a review lecture and tell you the exact problems that will be on the exam. As long as you go through those problems and the ones you've worked out in lecture, you'll be good.

I thought his lectures were really good and explained the material quite well. Like others have said, if you go to review classes, he very explicitly lays out what will be on the test which makes them very easy to do well on. If you go to class, you will get an A.

Short & Sweet:
1. His test are how he says they are, he gives you problems in the exam then LITERALLY JUST switches the numbers on the test. W man
2. His lectures are recorded & posted online AND he explains stuff twice to ensure u understand
3. just a chill guy

Great prof. Attendance is optional, and he records most of his lectures. Expectations and lectures are made very concise. He has review classes before each exam, which are vital, as he shows you how to do each problem that will be on the exam, just with the constants switched. Also has one python assignment (all 308 classes do) but makes it easy.

Dr. Tran is a great professor to take for MATH 308. His lectures are paced perfectly and he goes over everything you need to know, with no fluff or filler. There were a couple homework assignments and the class is very test heavy, but he goes over the exact concepts for each question prior to the exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Inspirational--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As a pure math major I somewhat dislike how the course (honors section) was mostly just solving problems through computations rather than much theory, but if you're an engineer this is probably what you want to take. Prof was nice, would basically give us the exam during the review class (only with constants altered), so it's not super challenging.

Dr. Tran is the prof to take for Diff Eq. The first week is quite daunting as his lectures are very fast-paced, but once you get the hang of things, it's not bad. There were only a few homeworks. He comprehensively reviews before each exam and the review is almost the same as the actual exam, just with different numbers. Take him!

This class is straight forward; homework and exams. His lectures are AMAZING and he actually explains the topics clearly. He is open to questions and wants everyone to understand. He does tons of examples which help with hwks and exams. He does an exam review which basically gives you the exam. So great and has EC. My favorite math prof yet!!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Literally gives you the test before you take it, even for the final. I had very little HW compared to my friends in other Diff Eq sections, even though I was in an honors section. Example problems done in class are applicable to the HWs and tests, and Dr. Tran is generally good at explaining the process to solve DEs. Also does extra credit.
Dr. Tran made this class really easy. His exams and homework are both very simple and straightforward. His lectures are great as well. Definitely the best diff eq professor.
He is a must take. Very clearly lays out what you need to on tests in the lecture. Do not have to go to all classes, but still need to understand the topics. Love him!
Easy prof. Goes over exactly what you need to know before the tests, so if you don't always know what's going on in lecture, that ok. Take, even if its the honors section.

His lectures were difficult to understand...whatever you do, don't take him for this class... especially if you're someone who finds Maths generally difficult and need someone to break the steps down. He's very blunt, and rude when you ask him a question. T's & G's

Hands down the best professor I've had in a math course. His lectures were at a decent pace and made some sense, even if you didn't fully grasp the concept. 

There were probably 7 homework assignments, all pretty short but they weighed 20%, so you should definitely do them. Tests were always consistent. Top prof for sure.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Excellent Prof! He made this class reasonably simple compared to what I have heard from other profs, and his exams had the same questions as the practice exam but were more complex. I am giving him a 4 and not a 5 because he did not bump/curve my 89.5 to an A and was kind of rude when I asked in an email, but I would still recommend 100%.
Amazing man.
W professor, especially compared to the subs we had throughout the semester. He is very clear when lecturing and pushes students to ask questions and makes sure students understand before moving on.

Minh has to be one of the best Math teachers I've ever experienced. His calm demeanor and concise language makes this class a breeze to take. After each example given in class, he explains it again but much quicker, so nothing goes missed. His homework's are short and valuable. They're drawn from a textbook but it can be found free online.
W professor
Yes

Lectures are amazing, he makes sure everyone understands what is going on in the lecture. The exams are clear, and the practice tests are very similar to the actual exam. There is very little homework given, but it is worth a lot of your grade, make sure you do it. Tran is a lot of other 308 professors because he can actually lecture.
